resources.string: Automatic updates are off by default. Review the account, source edition and branch. Remote services can change between readback and saving; uncertain sends require a check. Blank fields remain unchanged.

Only confirmed chapter completion is sent. The new workflow requires exact chapter completion enabled separately for each title. Existing legacy tracking remains for other titles. Integer-only services cannot accept fractional chapters. No titles are added automatically.
